cities.name: Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris 2026
cities.provenance_note: Published course GPX (Garmin Connect track, 602 points, 42.18 km).
cities.story: Biggest clean-to-dirty contrast of any course we looked at: the Bois sections are about a third of the NO2 seen beside the Peripherique.

cities.name: TCS London Marathon 2026
cities.provenance_note: AirTrack production route (986 waypoints, 42.39 km) from the official GPX.
cities.story: Steady and moderate. The dirtiest stretch is the final approach through the City, exactly where the crowds and the finish are.

cities.name: Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok 2025
cities.window_note: Marathon starts 02:00 local to beat the heat.
cities.provenance_note: Official published course GPX (575 trackpoints, 42.31 km), MBK Center to Sanam Luang via the Rama VIII Bridge. The line is the 2024 edition; the course was unchanged for 2025, which is the race day modelled here.
cities.model_prior: NASA GEOS-CF v2 archived forecast cycle (aqc collection)
cities.model_grid: EXPLORATORY grid - city not in the sealed v1.3 serving registry
cities.story: A 02:00 start puts the whole field under a nocturnal inversion. PM2.5 sat near five times the WHO guideline for the entire race.

cities.name: Accra International Marathon 2025
cities.window_note: Early start; Ghana runs on UTC year-round.
cities.provenance_note: Official AIM course measurement (KML, 1,844 points, 42.41 km): an out-and-back along the coastal Accra-Tema road. The line is the published 2026 measurement; the race day modelled is the 2025 edition on the same corridor.
cities.model_prior: NASA GEOS-CF v2 archived forecast cycle (aqc collection)
cities.model_grid: EXPLORATORY grid - city not in the sealed v1.3 serving registry
cities.story: Late-October coastal air is the cleanest of the three African/Asian cases here, but we have no ground truth in Ghana at all.

cities.name: Dakar Corniche running corridor
cities.window_note: Morning running window; YOG Dakar 2026 runs 31 Oct - 13 Nov.
cities.provenance_note: Not a marathon course: the Corniche Ouest, Dakar's main running corridor, routed from Stade Iba Mar Diop to Place du Souvenir Africain. Used to characterise early-November conditions around the Youth Olympic Games window.
cities.model_prior: NASA GEOS-CF v2 archived forecast cycle (aqc collection)
cities.story: Early November is a swing season. Our own model week moves PM2.5 from 9 to 47 in the space of a week - that variability, not the average, is the Games risk.
